mapper.select: SELECT u.id::text AS id, u.tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, u.status, (SELECT count(*) FROM optimization_record r WHERE r.created_by=u.id) AS records, (SELECT count(*) FROM optimization_record r WHERE r.created_by=u.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL) AS visible, (SELECT count(*) FROM workspace w WHERE w.created_by=u.id AND w.tenant_id=u.tenant_id) AS workspaces, (SELECT count(*) FROM workspace_member m JOIN workspace w ON w.id=m.workspace_id WHERE w.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND m.user_id != u.id) AS other_members, (SELECT count(*) FROM user_account other WHERE other.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND other.id != u.id) AS other_users FROM user_account u JOIN tenant t ON t.id=u.tenant_id WHERE u.display_name='本地业务验收' AND u.email IS NULL AND u.platform_role='USER' AND t.name='本地业务验收租户' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_identity i WHERE i.user_id=u.id AND i.identity_type='USERNAME' AND i.issuer='local' AND i.normalized_identifier ~ '^qa_[a-z0-9]{12,32}$') ORDER BY u.created_at

SELECT id::text FROM user_account WHERE id IN ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
